deities.name: Setrimir
deities.rationale: Constructed bodies made from replaceable memory ribbons fall directly under awakened life and artificial personhood.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Raeshkul
deities.rationale: Skill-bearing memory ribbons and continuity of personhood raise questions of intellect and higher understanding.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Nebyrr
deities.rationale: Their legal recognition as persons and communal stewardship of memory are tied to civilization and social order.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
